Your Dream Home is Calling #realestate 

🏡 Welcome to Your Next Home in Hartrick Ranch!
This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home sits on a spacious corner lot in the desirable Hartrick Ranch subdivision, built by Kiella Homes—known for quality and attention to detail.

📍 Conveniently located just minutes from the junction of State Highways 93 and 95, this home offers easy access to Samsung Austin, Baylor Scott & White, and VA Hospitals. It's also located in the Academy ISD—a great place to plant roots.

✨ Home Features:
– Split floor plan with a private master suite
– Open concept design—perfect for entertaining
– Elegant quartz countertops in the kitchen
– Spotless condition with beautiful landscaping
– Unique bonus: A/C unit in the garage, making it ideal for a workshop or hobby space year-round

From the clean lines to the thoughtful layout, this home checks all the boxes—and then some.

📞 Don’t just read about it—come see it for yourself!
